name: wsUnsubscribe
description: Accepted as a no-op for forward compatibility. In RustCFML, connections leave rooms through server-side socket.leave(), and the engine removes a connection from every room automatically on disconnect; there is no server-side unsubscribe to call. Feature-detecting code that calls wsUnsubscribe() will not error.

rustcfml.notes: No-op; room leaves are server-side via socket.leave() and are automatic on disconnect.
